def oloc(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='O':

    return None
def dots(frame):
    return sorted((min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']), min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])) for n in frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N')
def prev(frame):
    out=[]
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='g' and n['pixels']<20:
            b=n['boundary']
            out.append((min(p[0] for p in b), min(p[1] for p in b)))
    return out

def oloc(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='O':
            b=n['boundary']
            return (min(p[0] for p in b), min(p[1] for p in b))
    return None
def dots(frame):
    return sorted((min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']), min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])) for n in frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N')
def prev(frame):
    out=[]

        if n['color']=='g' and n['pixels']<20:
            b=n['boundary']
            out.append((min(p[0] for p in b), min(p[1] for p in b)))
    return out
